Name: WorldOrient
Description: Isolates rotation for selected controls by driving a sibling node via inverse matrix, locking their orientation to world space.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Forces the selected controls to always orient to the world (Z forward, Y up, X right), completely ignoring their parent's rotation.

How To Use:
  Select the controls in the scene and click 'Add Selected' below. Then click build.

Fields:
- SetControlsList: List of controls to process.
